logs.error.LOG_NOT_FOUND: Log {id} was not found — it may have been overwritten in the log buffer.
logs.error.ERROR_GROUP_NOT_FOUND: Error group {fingerprint} was not found — it may have expired.
logs.error.TRACE_NOT_FOUND: Nothing was found for {id}: no request, job, scheduler run or log carries this ID in the retained data.
logs.error.UNAVAILABLE: The log store is not reachable — logs cannot be queried right now. Live monitoring on other screens still works.
logs.error.LEVEL_DISABLED: Changing the log level is disabled (OPS_LOGS_LEVEL_ENABLED=false).
logs.error.LEVEL_PERMANENT_DISABLED: A level without expiry is not allowed (OPS_LOGS_LEVEL_PERMANENT_ENABLED=false) — choose a duration.
logs.error.RUNTIME_NOT_RUNNING: Runtime {runtime} is not running — its log level cannot be changed.
logs.error.NO_OVERRIDE: Runtime {runtime} has no temporary log level to revert.
